About.title: About
About.lead: Organic architecture shaped by place, landscape, and experience.
About.p1: Santiago Architecture is an international architecture and design studio founded by Gerardo Santiago Pineda.
About.p2: We work with private clients, developers, and investors on residences, villas, hospitality projects, and larger-scale developments.
About.p3: Our process combines architectural design, construction knowledge, spatial exploration, and advanced 3D modeling, allowing us to carry projects from early concepts toward realization.
About.p4: We aim to create architecture with its own identity: contemporary, sensitive to context, and designed to be experienced.
About.approach1: We do not understand architecture as an isolated object. Every project begins with place: its climate, landscape, light, vegetation, materials, and ways of living.
About.approach2: Three-dimensional modeling is part of the design process from the earliest stages, allowing us to explore spaces, geometries, and relationships that could hardly be developed in plan alone.

Services.title: Services
Services.lead: From the first idea through construction.
Services.intro: We design and develop projects of every scale for private clients, developers, and investors internationally.
Services.closing: We design architecture and carry it through to realization.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.body: We develop projects from the initial concept through full architectural definition, integrating function, materiality, landscape, and spatial experience.

designBuild.title: Design + Build
designBuild.body: We take the project from design through execution, preserving the architectural intent throughout and coordinating the teams needed to make it real.

residential.title: Residential
residential.body: We design singular residences shaped by place, the client's way of living, and the specific conditions of each site.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.body: We design hotels, resorts, villas, and hospitality spaces where architecture, landscape, and experience belong to one shared vision.

masterplan.title: Masterplanning
masterplan.body: We develop master plans for large-scale projects, integrating architecture, landscape, circulation, views, privacy, amenities, and future growth within a cohesive strategy.

development.title: Development & Investment
development.body: We work with developers and investors to turn land and real-estate opportunities into projects with identity, defining their architectural vision and spatial strategy.

largeScale.title: Large-scale Development
largeScale.body: We work on larger territorial and investment-driven projects, aligning architecture, landscape, and growth strategy.
